title: Futuristic fight city
content: So i had the most surreal dream that was totally insane but felt i mean literally real dream last night that felt like i was in another realm. To start I was considered a wonderer someone who could and had access to towns and cities that most didn't have access to, but certain places had certain conventions ob entering. I started visiting in a ritzy high-end city to help a friend with a demon problem I knew the church wouldn't do anything without a large payment and I knew a booze hound ex priest that needed a place to stay do I fetched him and brought him to the house. Since doing that I got temporary kicked out, on my way out I saw a couple of servants get bullied for reading and got into a fight and injured the lords son. The only place to go to was a city that valued strength NicknameNicknamed Fight city. This city was futuristic and lords from the neibooring city's gambled there and if one gets out any crime is forgiven and access tgrmost community's are granted. I was free to enter any domain but the servants were not. So we walked through the marsh to get to the underground monorail to get to this massive high-tech city. As soon as we got there it was fight after fight in these white steel rooms pushing people through windows. All the rules of a one on one were strongly removed because the lords wanted more blood. After what felt like hours of fighting we made it to the final stage and room, instead of granting us passage the lord of the city demanded us killed so I beat up a person with a knife and took out the lord and his possy. We finally made it out and went to a freeman's camp on the otherside by the marsh. That community is were the serservants stayed and I left to go to another city. I felt wat he'd by something the entire time
